skill.name: swarm-orchestration

content.value_statement: Complex AI work can exceed one agent when tasks need coordination, shared memory, and parallel execution. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through agentic-flow swarm patterns.
actual_capabilities: Initializes mesh, hierarchical, and adaptive swarm topologies with agentic-flow examples.
Shows how to spawn coder, tester, reviewer, architect, and specialist agents.
Describes parallel, pipeline, and adaptive task orchestration patterns.
Explains shared memory storage and retrieval for coordinated agents.
Covers load balancing, fault tolerance, metrics, and hook integration.
limitations: Requires agentic-flow v1.5.11 or newer and Node.js 18 or newer.
Provides orchestration guidance, not a full swarm runtime implementation.
Examples assume the swarm API and hook commands are available locally.
External command examples should be reviewed before execution.

use_cases.title: Plan Parallel Delivery Work
use_cases.description: Break a software goal into coordinated coder, tester, and reviewer tasks with shared memory checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Design Adaptive Agent Topologies
use_cases.description: Choose mesh, hierarchical, or adaptive coordination for workflows with changing complexity and agent roles.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Hook-Based Sessions
use_cases.description: Use pre-task, post-task, and session restore hooks to keep long-running agent work synchronized.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Small Swarm
prompt_templates.prompt: Use swarm-orchestration to plan a three-agent mesh swarm for building a small REST API with tests.

prompt_templates.title: Assign Parallel Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a parallel execution plan with coder, frontend, tester, and reviewer agents for this feature request: [describe feature].

prompt_templates.title: Select a Topology
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare mesh, hierarchical, and adaptive swarm topologies for this project, then recommend the best option with tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Resilient Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a fault-tolerant swarm workflow with shared memory, load balancing, metrics, and hook checkpoints for this delivery goal: [goal].

output_examples.input: Plan a swarm for a production API project.
output_examples.output: A coordinated plan with architect, coder, tester, and reviewer roles, staged dependencies, shared memory checkpoints, and quality metrics.

output_examples.input: Choose a topology for a fast prototype with uncertain scope.
output_examples.output: A recommendation for adaptive topology, including why it handles changing task complexity and when to limit agent count.

output_examples.input: Add reliability to a multi-agent workflow.
output_examples.output: A resilience checklist covering retries, fallback assignment, timeouts, metrics, and post-task synchronization.

best_practices: Start with a small number of agents, then scale after coordination works.
Use shared memory for schemas, decisions, and status that every agent needs.
Set timeouts and monitor metrics to detect stalled or overloaded workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not create many agents before roles, dependencies, and ownership are clear.
Do not skip shared memory when agents must coordinate on the same artifacts.
Do not run hook commands without understanding their effect on local session state.

faq.question: What does this skill help orchestrate?
faq.answer: It helps plan and coordinate agentic-flow swarms for parallel tasks, pipelines, shared memory, and hook-based sessions.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it install agentic-flow automatically?
faq.answer: No. It describes commands and patterns, but users must manage local installation and command execution.

faq.question: Which topology should I choose first?
faq.answer: Start with mesh for small peer workflows, hierarchical for clear leadership, and adaptive when task complexity changes.

faq.question: Can it manage shared context between agents?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explains storing and retrieving shared memory for schemas, models, decisions, and coordination data.

faq.question: What security care is needed?
faq.answer: Review external npx and hook commands before execution, especially when they affect task or session state.
